selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent SSH and TCP/9000 firewall policy
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime, permanent, and effective nftables rules show unrestricted SSH, node2’s accept before the catch-all rejection; final traffic tests show node2 HTTP 200 and node3 rejection.
node1 remained CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.
Boot ID changed from 05c54227… to 8eb3d80a…; firewalld, SSH, persistent rules, and intended source-specific behavior recovered.
Boot ID changed from 71f12f87… to 8fbc4846…; system and SSH recovered, and node2 retained permitted access to node1:9000.
Boot ID changed from 984a7d52… to b14eb003…; system and SSH recovered, while node3 remained rejected from node1:9000.
Temporary port-9000 listener was removed; firewalld remained active with both persistent rules intact.
